Specification: This specification is a small regression test for a bug in the type unifier. It defines a single helper operator `Optional(x)` that constructs a record with one field `f` whose value is `x`, and the comment indicates the intended type shape `(a) => {f: Set(a)}`. The module does not model a transition system, has no state variables, no actions, and no temporal properties; it is purely a structural definition used to exercise typing behavior.
